instruction: Please configure Chrome to automatically convert all prices on websites to my local currency with real-time exchange rates. I do a lot of international shopping and this would be very helpful.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not have a built-in feature to automatically detect and convert currency on web pages. While there are extensions that can provide some currency conversion functionality, Chrome's native settings do not include automatic real-time currency conversion with exchange rates for all websites.
